pins disponibles"echo "";;demo)echo "===== DÉMO ROBOT ====="echo ""echo "[1] Écran OLED allumé...""$BASE/i2c/i2c.sh" write 0 0x3C 0x00 0xAFecho ""echo "[2] Servomoteur bras droit position 90°...""$BASE/pwm/pwm.sh" set 0 50 7.5echo ""echo "[3] Servomoteur bras gauche position 90°...""$BASE/pwm/pwm.sh" set 1 50 7.5echo ""echo "[4] Lecture IMU (accéléromètre)...""$BASE/i2c/i2c.sh" read 0 0x68 0x3Becho ""echo "[5] Lecture capteur température...""$BASE/i2c/i2c.sh" read 0 0x76 0xFAecho ""echo "[6] LED GPIO 17 allumée...""$BASE/gpio/gpio.sh" mode 17 out"$BASE/gpio/gpio.sh"
